method_proposals.name: response_act_actor_referent_triangle
method_proposals.input: A field's question_text and response_options_all before comparing it with any other field.
method_proposals.transformation: Decompose each field into (a) response act (approve/disapprove rating, two-statement forced choice, nominal agent selection, interviewer evaluation), (b) actor/object named in the stem, and (c) referent/condition in the stem; refuse to treat shared option sets or shared topic words as evidence of a shared construct.
method_proposals.output: A per-field triple plus a merge-blocking note naming which element differs when a merge is proposed.
method_proposals.stop_condition: Stop when every proposed pair has an explicit differing element identified by literal stem/option text, or when no pair remains.
method_proposals.worked_positive_example: P2_SUBTLE: Q48A 'once elected, [members of Parliament] do their jobs' versus Q48B 'once elected, the [president] does [his] job'; identical options but the accountable target differs, so they are parallel not interchangeable.
method_proposals.worked_negative_example: P4_AMBIGUITY failure mode identified in P2_SUBTLE regression: calling Q22B and Q29B one 'military intervention in politics' scale when Q22B is an approve/disapprove rating of 'the army comes in to govern the country' and Q29B is a two-statement choice.
method_proposals.non_transfer_example: P4_AMBIGUITY Q109F: 'the respondent's attitude toward you during the interview' is interviewer-addressed and must not be read as respondent experience even though Q106D shares the topic 'during the interview'.
method_proposals.affected_reader: The directed worker composing candidate_relations, and the pair-assessment reviewer checking for false merges.
method_proposals.falsifying_trial: Apply to a fresh Afrobarometer item pair not in this packet (e.g. a different wave of Likert vs forced-choice governance items) and check whether the triangle flags the same textual discriminant; falsified if it produces a merge label that the literal stems contradict.

method_proposals.name: role_boundary_preservation
method_proposals.input: Two items with similar topic but different grammatical addressee (second-person respondent stem vs 'the respondent ... toward you' interviewer stem).
method_proposals.transformation: Assign each item a side (respondent-reported vs interviewer-reported) strictly from the stem's addressee, then mark any cross-side collapsed scale as a boundary violation.
method_proposals.output: A side label per field and an explicit block on cross-side merging, recorded as a rejected rival reading.
method_proposals.stop_condition: Stop when each compared field has a side assignment backed by a verbatim stem substring and any cross-side merge is marked rejected.
method_proposals.worked_positive_example: P4_AMBIGUITY: 'Did you feel threatened during the interview?' is respondent-side; 'What was the respondent's attitude toward you during the interview?' is interviewer-side, so the two must not form one fear/honesty construct.
method_proposals.worked_negative_example: A merge of Q106D 'Did you feel threatened' with Q106E 'Were you physically threatened' as one construct without routing text is left unresolved, not solved, because both are same-side but linkage is unproven.
method_proposals.non_transfer_example: P2_SUBTLE Q48A/Q48B: both are respondent-addressed nominal items, so the interviewer/respondent split does not apply; applying it there would be a misfire.
method_proposals.affected_reader: The pair-assessment reviewer deciding whether a directed claim survives adversarial reading.
method_proposals.falsifying_trial: Test on a fresh wave containing an interviewer-administered and a self-administered version of one item; falsified if the addressee-based side label does not predict which item records evaluator impression.

method_proposals.name: unobserved_gate_flagging
method_proposals.transformation: Flag every special code that encodes a non-administration, eligibility, or country-time gate (−1, 8, 9, 93, 94, 97) and attach it to its field so no comparison silently spans gated and ungated items.
method_proposals.output: A per-field gate inventory plus a comparability caution.
method_proposals.stop_condition: Stop when all special codes are listed verbatim with the field they belong to.
method_proposals.worked_positive_example: P2_SUBTLE: Q48A carries 'Not asked in Burkina Faso after 4th of October' while Q48B does not; Q63B carries 'Not applicable (COV1=0, 8 or 9)', so neither is assumed administered uniformly.
method_proposals.worked_negative_example: Inferring that Q63B was unasked everywhere because it has code 97 would overreach; the gate is a conditional non-applicability, not a frequency.
method_proposals.non_transfer_example: P4_AMBIGUITY fields Q106C/Q106D/Q106E/Q109F have empty response_options_special, so the gate inventory correctly reports no gate; treating their bare '0 = No | 1 = Yes' as proof of uniform administration would be unsupported.
method_proposals.affected_reader: The directed worker writing source_limits and the reader deciding cross-country comparability.
method_proposals.falsifying_trial: On a fresh round with country-by-item administration matrix, check whether a proposed comparable pair includes one gated item; falsified if a flagged gate does not coincide with a real administration gap.

response.no_change_rationale: Only case-level improvements are evidenced, not global novelty. P2_SUBTLE pair-assessment credits the directed pass with three gains: separating Q22B 'the army comes in to govern the country' from Q29B 'Agree with neither' forced choice, separating Q48A '[members of Parliament]' from Q48B 'the [president]', and blocking Q28 'must always obey the laws and the courts' from being read as military intervention. P4_AMBIGUITY credited role segregation via 'the respondent's attitude toward you'. But both records also list surviving regressions and unresolved dependencies: P2_SUBTLE misquotes Q48B and glosses Q29B 'abuse of power'; P4_AMBIGUITY leaves 'community and/or political party representatives' actor split, the Q106D/Q106E linkage, and '2 = In between' semantics unresolved. The proposals above formalize acts already visible in the directed outputs rather than asserting new capability, and no WVS execution or new respondent evidence is claimed.
next_falsifiable_trial: Re-run the response_act_actor_referent_triangle on a fresh matched Afrobarometer source containing at least one forced-choice and one rating item on the same topic, with an independent reviewer authenticated, and check whether the triangle flags the same discriminating stem text without any false merge; falsified if a false merge survives.

Re-run role_boundary_preservation on a fresh pair mixing an interviewer-addressed and a respondent-addressed item and record whether the side label predicts the evaluator impression; falsified if it does not.

Re-run unobserved_gate_flagging against a country-by-item administration matrix for Q48A and Q48B to test whether 'Not asked in Burkina Faso after 4th of October' is the only asymmetry; falsified if an unflagged administration gap appears.
